I do not have much money, and fertilizer is expensive — beans do not need much fertilizer anyway, they feed themselves from the soil. I will use the seed I saved from last year, like I always do, and I will work the plot myself with my hands. Maybe I will ask a young person from the village for a few days of help with weeding, if I can manage a little money or food to give them.
